title: Bayesian Distribution System State Estimation with Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.40728v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Medium-voltage feeders have few real-time measurements, so distribution system state estimation (DSSE) rests on pseudo-measurements of the secondary substations, a prior in Bayesian terms. Weighted least squares keeps the power flow exact but reduces this prior to a mean and variance, while supervised deep learning estimators also learn the power flow and are tied to one measurement set. We propose PoSE (posterior sampling for state estimation), which keeps the Bayesian structure of DSSE and learns only what the distribution system operator does not know, namely the distribution of substation injections, modelled by a neural network trained with flow matching on historical data. The power flow equations, grid topology and measurements enter only at sampling, through a noise-aware Kalman-type correction. translated_title: 基于流匹配的贝叶斯配电系统状态估计
translated_abstract: 中压馈线的实时量测很少，因此配电系统状态估计（DSSE）依赖于二次变电站的伪量测，在贝叶斯意义上这构成一种先验。加权最小二乘法虽然保持了潮流计算的精确性，却将该先验简化为均值和方差；而监督式深度学习估计器还会额外学习潮流，并且与特定的量测集绑定。我们提出了PoSE（面向状态估计的后验采样）方法，它保留了DSSE的贝叶斯结构，只学习配电系统运营商所不知道的内容，即变电站注入功率的分布，该分布由一个在历史数据上通过流匹配训练的神经网络来建模。潮流方程、电网拓扑和量测仅在采样阶段通过一种噪声感知的卡尔曼型修正进入模型。因此，该神经网络从不近似潮流计算，而每个后验样本都是一个物理上自洽的运行点。
tldr: 该论文提出PoSE方法，利用流匹配学习变电站注入功率的分布作为贝叶斯先验，并在采样阶段通过噪声感知的卡尔曼型修正融入潮流方程、拓扑和量测信息，使每个后验样本都是物理自洽的运行点，从而在保留配电系统状态估计贝叶斯结构的同时避免了神经网络对潮流的近似。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes PoSE, which uses flow matching to learn the distribution of substation injections as a Bayesian prior and incorporates power flow equations, topology, and measurements at sampling time via a noise-aware Kalman-type correction, so that every posterior sample is a physically consistent operating point while preserving the Bayesian structure of DSSE without the neural network approximating the power flow.
